title: Preservation of K-injective complexes by an additive functor
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an additive functor [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor]. Applying $F$ termwise gives a functor on integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $(F(K))^n=F(K^n)$ and differential $F(d_K^n)$. Say that $F$ preserves K-injective complexes if, for every K-injective cochain complex $K$ of $\mathcal C$ (the null-homotopy convention of [def-pur-kinjective-complex]), the termwise image $F(K)$ is K-injective in $\mathcal D$. Here K-injective means that every morphism into the complex from an acyclic complex is homotopic to zero. This is a property of the given additive functor and imposes no adjunction, exactness or boundedness hypothesis.
